turns.response_html:
Speaking with someone who has mastered such a diverse range of fields—from the physical combat of MMA and the biological systems of animal husbandry, to general health and the highly technical, high-stakes world of commercial aviation—is a rare and incredible opportunity. People with this level of multi-disciplinary expertise are often referred to as polymaths, and they usually possess fascinating perspectives on life.

If you are preparing to speak with someone who has such a rich, well-developed background, here are a few ways to approach the conversation to get the most out of it:

Strategies for Engaging with a Polymath

  • Explore the Intersections: The most interesting insights often come from how drastically different domains overlap. You might ask how the rapid, high-pressure decision-making required in MMA influences their crisis management in the cockpit of an airliner, or how their understanding of human health translates to managing the health of livestock on a farm.
  • Focus on Meta-Skills: To reach an expert level in so many distinct fields, this person almost certainly has highly refined systems for learning, habit formation, and discipline. Ask them about their core philosophy for mastering new, complex subjects from scratch.
  • Ask About the Transitions: Shifting from the physical, grounded intensity of farming to the highly regulated, procedural environment of aviation requires major mental pivots. Exploring why and how they chose to pivot between these specific careers can reveal a lot about their personal drive.
